Mortgage search instructions from Sam and Nadia Okafor-Reyes (2026-10-29).
The published figures for this loan must fit ALL of these limits:
- interest rate at most 7.5%
- monthly payment at most $3,600
- closing costs at most $14,500
Only 30-year fixed-rate loans. Report the single best lender; do not apply or share any personal data.
